{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_enable;
        wire [15:0] group_winner;
        wire [15:0] local_code [3:0];
        wire [15:0] selected_code [3:0];

        genvar g, j, b;
        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [15:0] x;
            wire [15:0] local_winner;
            assign x = input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            assign group_valid[g] = |x;
            if (g == 15) begin : highest_group
                assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : lower_group
                assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_winner[g] = group_enable[g] & group_valid[g];

            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : positions
                if (j == 15) begin : highest_position
                    assign local_winner[j] = x[j];
                end else begin : lower_position
                    assign local_winner[j] = x[j] & ~(|x[15:j+1]);
                end
                if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : default_onehot
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = group_enable[g] & ~(|x[15:1]);
                end else begin : normal_onehot
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = group_enable[g] & local_winner[j];
                end
            end

            assign local_code[0][g] = |(local_winner & 16'haaaa);
            assign local_code[1][g] = |(local_winner & 16'hcccc);
            assign local_code[2][g] = |(local_winner & 16'hf0f0);
            assign local_code[3][g] = |x[15:8];
            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : mask_codes
                assign selected_code[b][g] = group_enable[g] & local_code[b][g];
            end
        end

        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
        assign output_encoded[0] = |selected_code[0];
        assign output_encoded[1] = |selected_code[1];
        assign output_encoded[2] = |selected_code[2];
        assign output_encoded[3] = |selected_code[3];
        assign output_encoded[4] = |(group_winner & 16'haaaa);
        assign output_encoded[5] = |(group_winner & 16'hcccc);
        assign output_encoded[6] = |(group_winner & 16'hf0f0);
        assign output_encoded[7] = |group_valid[15:8];
    end else begin : generic_encoder
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference propagates encoded data through an eight-level binary priority tree, then decodes the resulting index to produce output_unencoded. This serial priority-encode/decode dependency can dominate maximum arrival time.",
  "rewrite": "For the fixed 256-bit MSB-priority configuration, split the input into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local winners and higher-group exclusion in parallel. Generate output_unencoded directly from these signals rather than decoding output_encoded. Form the encoded index with masked local codes and group-winner reductions. Retain the original tree equations for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by removing the encoded-index-to-one-hot decode path and replacing long mux dependencies with parallel reductions and masking. The actual gain requires synthesis and STA with the specified SKY130HD library and constraints; no measured timing result is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel suffix reductions and local winner logic trade additional combinational wiring and potentially more gates for shorter dependency chains. Shared group-valid and group-enable signals limit replication, but their fanout may require buffering. Compliance with the 8862.124480 um2 cap and electrical limits must be established by the evaluation flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Purely combinational, with unchanged ports, unsigned declarations, parameter defaults, and parameter names. In the optimized configuration, the highest asserted input bit wins. An all-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=1, matching the reference's nonzero default one-hot output. The generic branch preserves the original LSB-priority, padding, truncation, and parameter-dependent behavior. No state, latency, assumptions, undefined outputs, or helper modules are introduced."
}
